summary: Today’s tape looks mildly risk-off for crypto, with BTC retracing while ETH and SOL are comparatively steadier; the clearest positive macro cross-currents are in gold and Brent, while Reuters/Bloomberg headlines point to more regulatory friction for crypto. Community sentiment remains bullish on the majors, but today’s strongest new bearish call in the gathered material is UNI, with some broader weakness also showing up in BTC and SOL.
